fusions.name: Spore Bullet
fusions.desc: Fires a spore-packed round that deals 10 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Rot Harvest
fusions.desc: Fires into a festering target at or below 25% health, dealing 16 damage and consuming every affliction on it, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage. The health threshold rises with each rank.

fusions.name: Buried Puffball
fusions.desc: Plants a spore charge on the nearest enemy. It waits up to 20 seconds, and the first 2 enemies to come within 3 tiles take 20 damage in a blast around it.

fusions.name: Fruiting Wound
fusions.desc: Every hit you land seeds a spore in that enemy, up to 6. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: they burst for 27% of your weapon damage per spore (163% at full). Unfed, a spore fades every 4 seconds.
